name: gpu-fleet-viewer
description: A fast, privacy-friendly VS Code dashboard for monitoring NVIDIA GPU fleets over SSH
author: yruichen

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language

gpu-fleet-viewer.targets.description: List of SSH hosts to monitor

gpu-fleet-viewer.additionalHosts.description: Additional SSH targets (host alias, IP address, or user@host)

gpu-fleet-viewer.ignoredHosts.description: List of SSH hosts to ignore

gpu-fleet-viewer.sshTimeout.description: SSH connection and command timeout in seconds

gpu-fleet-viewer.maxConcurrentHosts.description: Maximum number of SSH hosts queried concurrently

gpu-fleet-viewer.pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause automatic SSH refreshes while the dashboard is hidden

gpu-fleet-viewer.compactLayout.description: Use a dense multi-column layout for servers with many GPUs

gpu-fleet-viewer.showPower.description: Show power draw and power limit

gpu-fleet-viewer.showFanSpeed.description: Show fan speed when reported by the GPU

gpu-fleet-viewer.showProcesses.description: Show GPU processes, owners, PIDs, and memory usage in a collapsible section

gpu-fleet-viewer.showHostHealth.description: Show lightweight CPU load, RAM, root disk, uptime, and SSH latency metrics

gpu-fleet-viewer.enableSlurmIntegration.description: Automatically associate GPU processes with Slurm jobs when Slurm is available

gpu-fleet-viewer.slurmRefreshInterval.description: Seconds between Slurm job metadata refreshes

gpu-fleet-viewer.availabilityRequireNoPr.description: Require a GPU to have no compute processes before it is considered available

gpu-fleet-viewer.availabilityMaxMemoryMi.description: Maximum used GPU memory in MiB for an available GPU

gpu-fleet-viewer.availabilityMaxUtilizat.description: Maximum GPU utilization percentage for an available GPU

gpu-fleet-viewer.showStatusBar.description: Show aggregate GPU availability in the VS Code status bar

gpu-fleet-viewer.enableNotifications.description: Show notifications when a GPU first crosses a warning threshold

gpu-fleet-viewer.notificationEvents.description: State transitions that may produce notifications when notifications are enabled

gpu-fleet-viewer.notificationCooldownSec.description: Minimum time between GPU Fleet notification batches

gpu-fleet-viewer.memoryWarningThreshold.description: Memory usage percentage that triggers warning styling

gpu-fleet-viewer.temperatureWarningThres.description: Temperature in Celsius that triggers warning styling

gpu-fleet-viewer.powerWarningThreshold.description: Power limit percentage that triggers warning styling

gpu-fleet-viewer.researchUser.description: Remote username used by the My tasks filter.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.protocol.description: Custom AI API protocol. Requests occur only when you send a question.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.baseUrl.description: AI API base URL or full endpoint. Set the key separately using the dashboard Settings.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.model.description: Model ID supplied by your AI provider.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.saveChatHistory.description: Save conversation text in local VS Code storage. Tool evidence and Full Access permissions are not persisted.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for each model response in seconds; not a total investigation time limit.

gpu-fleet-viewer.visibleGpus.description: Visible GPU indices or UUIDs per SSH host. Omitted host = all GPUs; empty list = none. Affects dashboard and default AI scope, not existing reminders.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.maxToolCalls.description: Tool calls per turn; 0 means no fixed count limit. A configured cap pauses with continuation.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.logTailLines.description: Maximum task log tail lines per read.

gpu-fleet-viewer.ai.logTailKiB.description: Maximum task log tail read size in KiB. Exact-file authorization still applies.

scripts.dev: npm run compile && node scripts/renderPreview.js && python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: node scripts/checkLocales.js && node ./out/test/manual_test.js && node scripts/checkAi.js && node scripts/checkTaskQueries.js && node scripts/checkReminders.js && node scripts/checkAssistant.js && node scripts/checkRelease.js && node scripts/checkRefresh.js && npm run preview:build && node scripts/checkWebview.js
